t2.thesis: Severe recent de-risking after the zero-coupon convertible note dilution, coupled with 26.8% short interest, strong call option skew, and a 75% historical open win rate, sets up an asymmetric relief reaction on operational HPC milestone updates.
reasons: The stock has dropped ~49% over the past month following the $850M convertible offering and debt-for-equity swap, substantially discounting near-term financing overhang.
Options pricing displays a notable call skew (ATM call IV 154% vs put IV 135%) and very low put/call volume ratio (0.24), indicating speculative demand for upside convexity.

CIFR has gained at the open in 3 of its last 4 earnings prints (+14.5%, +9.3%, +7.0%, -7.2%) despite large GAAP EPS misses, as the market trades it on HPC lease milestones rather than legacy mining earnings.
High short interest of 26.8% of float creates fertile ground for an open squeeze if data center delivery timelines at Black Pearl and Barber Lake remain on track.
t2.deciding_variable: Updates on HPC delivery milestones and initial rent commencement at Black Pearl and Barber Lake versus construction capex run-rates.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved up +0.022 from BMO base rate of 0.548 to 0.570 due to extreme one-month oversold conditions (-49%), 26.8% short interest, positive historical open win rate (75%), and bullish call-put IV skew, partially offset by ongoing capex cash burn risks.

theses.expected: Cipher confirms initial rent commencement at Black Pearl and affirms on-schedule delivery for Barber Lake Phase I in Q4 2026.
theses.mechanism: Validates the commercial execution of the HPC pivot, prompting short-covering given 26.8% short float and severe recent drawdown.
theses.wrong_if: Management reports construction delays, cost overruns exceeding tenant reimbursement caps, or further equity dilution.

theses.expected: Legacy bitcoin mining gross margins remain compressed but are discounted by the market.
theses.mechanism: Investors focus almost entirely on contracted backlog ($9B+ at Barber Lake) and contracted capacity rather than quarterly mining EPS.
theses.wrong_if: The market reacts punitively to high net cash burn or wider operating losses.

theses.expected: Positive price momentum over the Friday pre-earnings session carries through the weekend into a gap up on Monday.
theses.mechanism: Anticipatory positioning into high-beta AI infrastructure names following the completed note offering overhang lift.
theses.wrong_if: Macro headwinds or crypto market weakness drags peer neocloud/HPC proxy valuations lower on Friday.

key_observations: Commencement date and dollar contribution of initial HPC rental revenue from Black Pearl
Barber Lake construction budget status and whether Capex exceeds the $359.3M initial threshold
Updates on tenant demand and prospective lease agreements for the 900 MW Apollo site option
Cash and liquidity position following the $850M convertible notes issuance and capital expenditure commitments
